summary: fractal-web restores the Resources inspector and Conversation menu in the thread header, reads observed resources and agent queue data, preserves each resource's reported type, state and observation age, and hides unrecognized protocol events by default; the Conversation menu's global, identity-free Show all system events preference reveals them as payload-free notices without exposing their kinds or payloads

replay.detail: Client-only change; no runtime replay change.

compatibility.detail: Client-only change against existing gateway routes.

manual.detail: No deployed installation action required; the app is not deployed by this change.

recovery.detail: No database or runtime recovery change.
